name: Chester
description: A mule owned by Zagorka on Otaria, her trusted friend and companion, enlarged by Krosa's mutating power.

description_citations.text: "Chester". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A guard at Aphetto gives Chester a mortal wound as payment when Zagorka cannot afford the entrance fee.
timeline.quote: the guard gave Chester a mortal wound as payment

citation.text: "Chester", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl resuscitates Chester, and Krosa's mutating power makes him far larger and stronger.
timeline.quote: Kamahl resuscitated Chester back to life with his newfound powers

citation.text: "Chester", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zagorka rides Chester in the Nightmare War, and he saves her life escaping Phage's death wurms.
timeline.quote: he saved her life when they escaped the terrible nightmare death wurms that were spawned by Phage

citation.text: "Chester", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chester, Zagorka and Stonebrow find the entrance to Averru, which Zagorka names Sanctum.
timeline.quote: eventually stumbled over the crumbled entrance to the city of Averru

citation.text: "Chester", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When the Glyphs rise, Chester helps victims escape by kicking down walls and destroying Glyphs; he is separated from Zagorka, who is trapped and dies.
timeline.quote: Zagorka perished during the Rebirth of Karona
